precipitation_nowcast_verification.calibration_policy: paired prospective Brier gate; calibrated probability is disabled to raw wherever calibrated Brier is worse after the minimum sample count
precipitation_nowcast_verification.radar_policy: the existing official GeoMet radar extrapolated rain-rate signal is archived at issue time as near-term context; it is not mislabeled as a synthetic 2-6h extrapolation
precipitation_nowcast_verification.truth_policy: location-official station hourly precipitation when time-aligned; official radar occurrence as fallback; RDPA 6h accumulation retained as separate intensity truth

rain_timing_verification.calibration_policy: paired prospective Brier gate; calibrated probability is disabled to raw wherever calibrated Brier is worse after the minimum sample count
rain_timing_verification.radar_policy: the existing official GeoMet radar extrapolated rain-rate signal is archived at issue time as near-term context; it is not mislabeled as a synthetic 2-6h extrapolation
rain_timing_verification.truth_policy: location-official station hourly precipitation when time-aligned; official radar occurrence as fallback; RDPA 6h accumulation retained as separate intensity truth

real_feel.formula_validation: comparative independent references; no synthetic single observed Real Feel target
real_feel.method: provider apparent production champion; Steadman/wind-chill fallback; local residual remains shadow-only while independent formula replay accumulates

real_feel_formula_replay.method: Issued Real Feel candidates are compared prospectively against separate external references derived from target-time location-official meteorology; no candidate formula is declared observed human-perception truth.
real_feel_formula_replay.promotion_policy: diagnostic-only while the independent replay accumulates; Real Feel formula changes are not auto-promoted from the legacy synthetic target

references.bom_steadman_shade: Steadman apparent temperature using observed temperature, humidity and wind
references.eccc_humidex: ECCC Humidex only when air temperature is at least 20 C and Humidex is at least 1 C above air temperature
references.eccc_wind_chill: Canadian wind chill when observed temperature/wind satisfy the cold-weather formula inputs
